gaps.lead: He is so impatient that he never reads instructions.
gaps.explanation: so impatient that he never reads = too impatient to read.

gaps.lead: 'Have you finished the report?' the manager asked her.
gaps.explanation: Yes/no questions are reported with if/whether + statement word order.

gaps.lead: 'Would you like me to carry that?' he offered.
gaps.explanation: offer to do something: offered to carry.

gaps.lead: His salary is low, but he enjoys his work.
gaps.explanation: …though his salary is low — 'though' links the concession.

gaps.lead: I'm sure he isn't in Spain — he was here this morning.
gaps.sentence: He ___ in Spain — he was here this morning.
gaps.explanation: can't be = certainty that something is impossible (present).

gaps.lead: The plane had just taken off when the warning light appeared.
gaps.sentence: The plane had ___ when the warning light appeared.
gaps.explanation: had just + participle = a very short time before.
